examples.description: Who can legally sign for a Norwegian company, and how

description: Who can legally sign for this Norwegian company, and how? Call get_company_verification first; this ignores bankruptcy and dissolution. The class (sole, joint, by_role, prokura_only, no_authority, unknown) comes from Fullmakttjenesten and the role holders; `coded_authority` (absent in sandbox) adds coded clauses and stamps. Statutory authority, not Altinn delegation. UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, VALIDATION_FAILED; a credential without `read:brreg` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). For a person's actions use list_acting_capacity; for your own delegation use check_authorization. No API key? Use Bearer apier_sandbox_test_<suffix> (a fresh suffix) to get fixtures; valid orgs are the 818, 99966 and 99977 series and 999000002 (see GET /api/v1/sandbox/fixtures). Cost: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per call, prepaid (prices: the get_pricing tool or GET /api/v1/pricing; a shortfall returns INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS with top_up_url). Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/signature-rights-norwegian-company
description_nb: Svar på «hvem kan signere lovlig for dette selskapet, og hvordan?». Kall get_company_verification først: signaturretten gjenspeiler ikke konkurs eller oppløsning. Deterministisk signeringsklassifisering fra Fullmakttjenesten og rolleinnehaverne; `coded_authority` mangler i sandkassesvar. Ingen lovhjemmel påstås. For en persons handlinger, bruk list_acting_capacity; for konsumentens delegering, bruk check_authorization. Krever read:brreg. Kostnad: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per kall, forhåndsbetalt (priser: verktøyet get_pricing eller GET /api/v1/pricing; for lav saldo gir INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS med top_up_url).

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (Brønnøysund ID); MOD-11-checked up-front — a failing value is rejected as VALIDATION_FAILED, so correct the number rather than retrying it.

name: get_company_authority

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The /authority answer: a deterministic `classification`, `combinations[]`, the `signaturrett_holders` / `prokura_holders` lists, `kombinasjon_available`, and the stamp-honest `coded_authority` model over the mirrored clauses. No legal citation is asserted.
